verdict.rationale: Foreloop gathers end-user feedback through an embeddable widget. Submissions land in a central organization Feedback list, or are routed to a project, after spam triage, and an agent turns reports into intentions. That covers a central intake for customer feedback, but nothing shows the list is searchable or that internal colleague requests flow into the same repository. Missing for 10: evidence of search/filtering over the feedback list, intake of colleague/internal requests into the same store, independent or hands-on corroboration.
